name: Kelme
verdict: Owned by New Millennium Sports, S.L., a Spanish sportswear company based in Elche (Alicante). Nothing found.
note: Kit maker of Espanyol since 2018-19, renewed through 2030 (Kelme's own Espanyol collection page; La Grada, 2026-03-26). Ownership taken from Kelme's own legal notice; no public shareholder register found beyond the company itself, no state owner, nothing adverse found.
